milestones.description: Documented freebie task. Uses inventory_has to verify player possesses the stone_axe given at spawn. This milestone is trivially satisfied at frame 0 because the stone_axe is given via /give command. It serves as a baseline entry point task with no outgoing dependency edges. No available rule type can verify the UI action of opening inventory, so this is the least-bad option and is honestly documented as a freebie.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate ~20 blocks south to the jungle area and look at the jungle trees. Target is the primary jungle tree center at [8, 2, 18] (distance ~19.7 from spawn). Max distance 8 requires at least ~11.7 blocks of travel from spawn origin. Facing tolerance 60 degrees ensures the player is oriented toward the jungle trees, not just passing nearby.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate to the bamboo cluster within the jungle area at [10, 1, 16] (distance ~18.9 from spawn) and face it. Max distance 6 requires close proximity (~12.9 blocks minimum travel) since bamboo stalks are thin green sticks that need close inspection to identify.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must locate the beehive attached to the second jungle tree at [12, 3, 20] (distance ~23.3 from spawn). The beehive is elevated at y=3, directly east-adjacent to the trunk at [11, 3, 20]. Max distance 6 requires ~17.3 blocks minimum travel and close proximity to distinguish the beehive from surrounding leaves.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate ~15 blocks west to the dark oak structure and face the door on its east wall at [-13, 1, 7] (distance ~14.8 from spawn). Door faces east toward the approaching player. Max distance 5 requires ~9.8 blocks minimum travel, placing the player essentially at the entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the dark oak button at [-13, 2, 6] is a very small block element (1/16 block protrusion from wall) requiring close inspection. Max distance 4 and facing tolerance 45 degrees require the player to be right next to the wall and looking directly at the button location, one block north of and above the door.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must find the 2x3 gray stained glass window on the west (back) wall of the structure at [-18, 2, 7] (distance ~19.2 from spawn). Viewable from inside the structure after entering through the door, or from the west exterior. Max distance 6 requires ~13.2 blocks minimum travel and accommodates both viewing approaches.

Uses inventory_has because when the player mines an acacia_log block from the tree at [14, 0-3, 2] using their stone axe, the acacia_log item drops and enters their inventory. The item is not in starting inventory, so its presence directly and reliably verifies that mining occurred.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an acacia_door (from 6 acacia planks arranged in 2x3 pattern on a placed crafting table) places the resulting acacia_door item into the player's inventory. The item was not in starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful multi-step crafting (mine logs → convert to planks → craft door). Intentional high difficulty requiring Minecraft recipe knowledge.
